description: Conformance vectors for the W1 Notary verdict function (spec 11). The Rust implementation (warrantor-notary) MUST produce the expected verdict for each. The Python implementation (warrantor_notary) does NOT re-implement the verdict (spec 11 §1: one authoritative implementation); it Verifies the receipts the Rust notary issues over these vectors, proving the decision is reproducible + the proof is third-party-verifiable.
note_on_authoritative_implementation: Unlike the M1 agent-manifest vectors (where both languages implement the same parser), the W1 verdict function is implemented ONCE in Rust. Python's contract is Verify-only. The vectors below are consumed by Rust to assert decisions; the interop check (Rust issues a receipt per vector → Python verifies it) is the cross-language proof.

vectors.name: all_pass_allow
vectors.description: Every gate passes; the verdict is Allow with the actor's own capabilities (sorted).

vectors.name: gate1_containment
vectors.description: A kill-switch is active for the 'prod' scope → Deny at Containment, before any other gate.

vectors.name: gate2_identity_revoked
vectors.description: The actor's SVID is revoked → Deny at Identity.

vectors.name: gate2_identity_expired
vectors.description: The SVID expired before ctx.now → Deny at Identity.

vectors.name: gate3_freshness_replay
vectors.description: Nonce already seen → Deny at Freshness (replay protection).

vectors.name: gate3_freshness_stale
vectors.description: Timestamp is outside the freshness window → Deny at Freshness.

vectors.name: gate4_chain_broken_signature
vectors.description: A delegation link's signature does not verify → Deny at Chain.

vectors.name: gate5_authority_outside_intersection
vectors.description: Requested 'financial' is not in the actor's capabilities → Deny at Authority.

vectors.name: gate5_authority_union_trap
vectors.description: The union trap (spec 12): a chain link that drops 'write' removes it from the intersection.

vectors.name: gate6_artifacts_unverified
vectors.description: An artifact digest is not verified → Deny at Artifacts.

vectors.name: gate7_budget_exhausted
vectors.description: Autonomy budget is zero → Deny at Budget.

vectors.name: gate8_policy_denied
vectors.description: The policy engine returns deny → Deny at Policy.

vectors.name: gate9_approval_missing_for_critical
vectors.description: A critical action with no human approval → Deny at Approval.

vectors.name: gate9_approval_delegable_for_critical
vectors.description: A critical action with a delegable approval (not non-delegable) → still Deny at Approval.

vectors.name: gate9_approval_valid_non_delegable_allows
vectors.description: A critical action with a valid, non-delegable human approval → Allow.

vectors.name: ordering_containment_short_circuits_before_all_others
vectors.description: Every gate would fail, but Containment (gate 1) must win — proving normative order.
